prompt: A young human wizard in cerulean and sapphire robes, side profile facing right, one hand thrust forward channeling a stream of pale cyan frost. The frost strikes a charging wolf, freezing it solid mid-leap: its legs locked, ice crusting its fur, frozen in place. The background is a dark snow-dusted stone hall lit only by the cold blue glow of the spell.

Close-up of a snarling beast frozen solid in a block of cracked blue ice, jaws open mid-roar, body locked rigid and immobilized, frost feathering across its surface. In the small distant background a robed human wizard lowers his outstretched hand. The background is a frozen dark cavern lit by the cold cyan glow of the ice.

A human wizard in deep sapphire robes stands facing the viewer, both hands raised, conjuring shackles and chains made of jagged translucent ice that snake out and wrap around a struggling armored soldier, binding his arms and legs so he cannot move. The background is a wintry stone courtyard at dusk, lit by the pale blue glow of the frost magic.

Worm-eye low angle looking up at a charging knight on horseback caught and frozen mid-gallop, the horse and rider encased in a sheet of cracking pale-blue ice, hooves locked off the ground. A small cloaked wizard stands at the bottom edge with hand raised. The background is a grey wintry sky over a snowfield, the only warm-cold light the cyan shimmer of the ice.

A stern human wizard in icy-white and cerulean robes, three-quarter view, calmly pointing one finger. From the fingertip a thin ray of frost lances out and freezes a leaping goblin in place, the goblin caught rigid in a glaze of ice, mouth agape. The background is a dim blue stone dungeon corridor, lit only by the cold light of the frost ray.

A frost wizard with frost-white hair and a cobalt-blue cloak, side profile facing left, hands spread apart as a wall of glittering ice crystals erupts from the ground and encases a hulking ogre up to its chest, the ogre straining but held fast. The background is a snow-covered ruined temple under a pale grey sky, lit by the cyan sheen of the ice.

A human wizard in sapphire robes seen from behind, arms raised, facing a great frozen serpent that rears up before him completely sheathed in cracked blue ice, its coils locked rigid and immobilized. The background is a frozen lake under a dark night sky, the cyan glow of the entombing ice the only light.

A confident human wizard in flowing cerulean and silver robes stands centered, one palm out and glowing with a sphere of swirling pale-blue frost magic, ice crystals drifting around him. At his feet a wolf is half-frozen in creeping rime, locked in place. The background is a dark vaulted stone hall, lit by the cold sapphire light of the frost orb.
